name: tokenlite-mysql-mcp
description: A secure, efficient, and intelligent MySQL database server for the Model Context Protocol
long_description: A highly optimized MySQL MCP server designed specifically for AI agents and coding assistants. It resolves typical context bloat and performance issues through a unique Graph-Based Semantic Schema (localizing schema discovery to Target + 1-hop relationships), strict Safe-Query Optimizer (preventing heavy unindexed table scans via AST parsing and EXPLAIN limits), Granular AST-Based Write Firewall (default read-only with surgical opt-in permissions), Session-Level Defense in Depth, and dense CSV token compression.

mcp_explain_max_scan_rows.title: EXPLAIN Max Scan Rows
mcp_explain_max_scan_rows.description: EXPLAIN guardrail: max estimated rows for unindexed full table scans before blocking the query.

mcp_query_row_limit.title: Query Row Limit
mcp_query_row_limit.description: Max rows returned per SELECT (AST-injected LIMIT and truncation footer).

mcp_safe_query_enable_blocking.title: Enable Blocking Guardrail
mcp_safe_query_enable_blocking.description: Enable or disable the EXPLAIN guardrail.

mcp_metadata_path.title: Metadata Path
mcp_metadata_path.description: Absolute path to your custom metadata.json dictionary.

mcp_templates_path.title: Templates Path
mcp_templates_path.description: Absolute path to your custom templates.json queries.

mcp_rate_limit_rpm.title: Rate Limit (RPM)
mcp_rate_limit_rpm.description: Max tool invocations per minute (sliding window). Set to 0 to disable.

allow_insert_operation.title: Allow INSERT Queries
allow_insert_operation.description: Enable INSERT and REPLACE queries (default read-only is false).

allow_update_operation.title: Allow UPDATE Queries
allow_update_operation.description: Enable UPDATE queries (default read-only is false).

allow_delete_operation.title: Allow DELETE Queries
allow_delete_operation.description: Enable DELETE and TRUNCATE queries (default read-only is false).

allow_ddl_operation.title: Allow DDL Queries
allow_ddl_operation.description: Enable Data Definition Language like CREATE, ALTER, DROP, RENAME (default is false).

db_ssl.title: Enable TLS
db_ssl.description: Enable TLS for the MySQL connection (recommended for managed/cloud databases).

db_ssl_reject_unauthorized.title: Reject Unauthorized TLS Certificates
db_ssl_reject_unauthorized.description: Reject self-signed or untrusted TLS certificates when DB_SSL is enabled.
